subject.label: sport
subject._note: School of Sport container context, not a single discipline. It spans sport and exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength and conditioning. There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport and exercise science / sport domain knowledge.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for creativity-introductory. Frames creative thinking for the School of Sport as a whole, drawing its worked examples from across the school's subjects and varying the subject lesson to lesson (L01 sport and exercise science, L02 sport coaching, L03 sport management and development).
